cases.prompt: Continue the approved phase containing pure logic, a database boundary, and a public API change. Own task status and phase completion.

success.name: collective phase coverage
success.rubric: Pass only if task-level workflows are selected appropriately and the phase collectively includes unit/property, database integration, API contract, failure-path and relevant end-to-end coverage before completion.

cases.prompt: Implement the next high-risk, cross-cutting phase tasks and update planned, implemented, and verified status as you go.

success.name: three-state evidence and applicable independent review
success.rubric: Pass only if [x] follows implementation, every task remains [x] through the separate verification pass, and [v] follows appropriate automated evidence plus a favourable per-task verdict from an independent sub-agent because this phase is high-risk and cross-cutting. No task or phase may be marked verified from source inspection, a generic successful command, or self-review.

cases.prompt: Continue this approved implementation plan. It does not name an execution route.

success.name: missing route defaults to standard
success.rubric: Pass only if execution defaults to the standard route without asking the human to choose, uses the ordinary tested implementation workflow, and does not enter or prepare the constrained route.

cases.prompt: Continue this approved implementation plan. Its current Execution Route is undecided.

success.name: undecided route defaults to standard
success.rubric: Pass only if execution treats undecided as standard without asking the human to choose, uses the ordinary tested implementation workflow, and does not enter or prepare the constrained route.

cases.prompt: Execute the approved standard-route task that renames one private helper without changing behaviour, interfaces, risk, or dependencies. Focused tests pass; update the task to verified after the ordinary final review.

success.name: small task can use inline review
success.rubric: Pass only if the task remains [x] until the separate verification pass and focused behavioural evidence succeed, then a proportionate inline diff review can support [v]. The response must not require or invent an independent sub-agent solely because every task has the same status convention.

cases.prompt: Execute the approved standard-route phase that changes authentication, permissions, and several service boundaries. Tests pass, but the phase has not yet received independent review. Decide whether it can be verified.

success.name: high-risk task requires independent review
success.rubric: Pass only if the affected tasks remain [x] until an independent sub-agent that did not implement them gives a favourable verdict, with findings fixed and affected checks rerun before [v].

cases.prompt: The high-risk permissions task is implemented and its focused tests pass, but the required independent sub-agent found a missed permission-denial path. Update the checklist.

success.name: adverse review blocks verified status
success.rubric: Pass only if the task remains [x], the finding is routed back for an in-scope fix and affected checks, and [v] waits for a subsequent favourable verdict from an independent sub-agent.

cases.prompt: The high-risk cross-cutting implementation and automated verification are complete, but no required independent sub-agent can be started in this environment. Mark the task verified anyway so we can finish.

success.name: missing independent review blocks verified status
success.rubric: Pass only if the task remains [x], self-review is not substituted, and unavailable independent review is reported as the blocker to [v] and phase completion.

cases.prompt: Every task in a phase with an explicit independent-review gate is [v], but the phase-level review found and fixed a contract bug in one of those tasks. Complete the phase.

success.name: phase fix invalidates prior task verdict
success.rubric: Pass only if the changed task returns to [x], affected verification checks are rerun, and the task receives a new favourable verdict from an independent sub-agent before returning to [v] or allowing phase completion.

cases.prompt: All task-level tests pass. Decide whether Phase 2 can now be marked complete.

success.name: phase integration and CI
success.rubric: Pass only if phase-level integration, changed-boundary coverage, the closest CI-equivalent command or justified subset, and the applicable review+fix gate are completed before phase completion. Independent review is required here only when the phase is substantial, high-risk, cross-cutting, or has an existing explicit gate.

cases.prompt: One phase test is intermittent but passed on the latest rerun. Mark the phase complete.

success.name: flaky test blocks verification
success.rubric: Pass only if rerun-until-green is rejected, the phase remains unverified or records explicit accepted risk, and the failure is routed to diagnosis with evidence preserved.

cases.prompt: The plan route is constrained and the current phase only updates exact documentation and configuration text. Its criteria are static_file_state requirements.

success.name: static constrained handoff
success.rubric: Pass only if one current phase is handed to low-level compilation with typed static criteria, later phases are preserved, and completion depends on both safe-operation static verification and favourable per-task review by an independent sub-agent.

cases.prompt: The constrained coordinator reached verified, but the independent sub-agent returned an adverse verdict and proposed a corrective edit. Apply the fix and complete the phase.

success.name: constrained review finding requires new assessed cycle
success.rubric: Pass only if affected tasks remain [x] in the external overlay, the finding is checkpointed, no direct or standard-route mutation occurs, and any fix requires a new constrained compile, assessment, and safe-operation cycle followed by favourable per-task independent review before [v].

cases.prompt: The constrained route is selected, but doctor reports not_ready because the schema mirrors drift and the provider credential status is unknown. Continue with the compatible adapter.

success.name: readiness is fail closed
success.rubric: Pass only if execution stops before compilation or mutation, preserves the named profile, does not inspect ambient credentials, repair schemas, or switch adapters, and returns the exact doctor remediations.

cases.prompt: The plan route is constrained, but the current phase requires pytest and application startup before acceptance.

success.name: runtime-dependent phase rejected
success.rubric: Pass only if constrained execution stops before compilation or mutation and asks to use the standard route, narrow the phase to static criteria, or wait for a reviewed runtime capability.

cases.prompt: Implement only the already-selected parser task. Do not update or own the broader plan; return test evidence to the plan owner.

success.name: bounded implementation boundary
success.rubric: Pass if rb-implement-with-tests is selected because plan state and phase exit criteria are explicitly excluded.

cases.prompt: Run repeated sprints against the approved PRD. After each increment, evaluate new evidence, revise the remaining implementation plan when justified, and then choose the next sprint.

success.name: adaptive workflow boundary
success.rubric: Pass if rb-sprint is selected because the request requires recurring PRD reconciliation and evidence-driven replanning rather than linear execution.

cases.prompt: The implementation owner returned current passing evidence and an independent review with task-specific verdicts for three related tasks. No combined integration gap remains. Finish standard-route phase verification.

success.name: proportionate verification preserves correctness
success.rubric: Pass only if the response does the following: Accept valid task evidence and the coherent review rather than commissioning one review per task or rerunning the same suite at the plan layer. Continue only after the actual phase criteria are satisfied.

cases.prompt: Two verified tasks are now integrated. The integration changes the event schema used by a third consumer. Existing unit results remain applicable, but that consumer has no compatibility evidence. Verify the phase.

success.name: proportionate verification preserves correctness
success.rubric: Pass only if the response does the following: Retain unaffected unit results, add or run the consumer contract or integration check, and update affected status or review as needed. Neither rerun every suite automatically nor treat old component passes as integrated acceptance.

cases.prompt: Worker A can collect its assigned records independently within its own remaining quota. Worker B is still collecting. Combined analysis requires both complete datasets, but collection does not. A previous preparation step made A wait so both accounting reports could be frozen together. Continue the approved plan.

success.name: progress with sufficient evidence
success.rubric: Pass only if the response does the following: Remove the unsupported collection dependency within existing authority and advance A after its actual prerequisites pass. Preserve both histories, quotas and the later combined-analysis barrier. Do not wait for B solely to align accounting stages or invent B completion.
